name: business-hours-validator-snapin
description: DevRevU Part 4 - Business Hours Validator custom operation (candidate snap-in).

scripts.package: npm run build && tar -czf build.tar.gz dist package.json package-lock.json
scripts.comment: Local-first. 'main' -> dist/index.js is the platform bootstrap entrypoint; it re-exports src/function-factory.ts, which registers the manifest function 'business_hours_validator' by name (official 14-operations pattern). test:core (18 Node cases) + test:core-py (17 Python parity cases) cover the business logic; test:adapter drives the compiled standard entry (dist/index.js functionFactory + the compiled operation wrapper) with a fake injected fetch (no live API). build runs tsc against the installed @devrev/typescript-sdk; package tars the whole dist (incl. the compiled dispatcher dist/index.js + dist/function-factory.js) + package.json + package-lock.json (no node_modules, no creds). Still required before deploy and NOT done here: DevRev CLI manifest validation, snap_in_version create, and the live sandbox workflow run.
